# Overrides applied when compiling semgrep.txt (uv pip compile --override).
#
# mcp: semgrep pins mcp==1.29.0 (1.180.0 through 1.182.1 alike), and every mcp
# from 1.8.0 up to 1.29.x is affected by GHSA-84m7-p3x7-pcfv (unbounded session
# accumulation in the StreamableHTTP transport), fixed in 1.30.0. semgrep imports mcp
# only in its MCP server, never in `semgrep scan`, which is all semgrep.yaml runs.
# semgrep.yaml installs with --no-deps so pip does not re-apply semgrep's pin. Delete
# this line once a semgrep release allows mcp 1.30.
mcp>=1.30.0,<2
#
# opentelemetry-*: semgrep pins opentelemetry-api~=1.37.0 (still true of semgrep
# 1.182.1), which is affected by GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h "Unbounded tracestate parsing
# in opentelemetry-api" (vulnerable <= 1.45.0; Dependabot alert #37). 1.45.1 is the
# patched release. The sdk, exporter, proto and instrumentation packages are
# released in lockstep with the api (1.x / 0.yb), so the whole family moves
# together to 1.45.x / 0.66bx. The caps keep this to the security fix. Delete these
# lines once semgrep's own pins reach 1.45.1.
opentelemetry-api>=1.45.1,<1.46
opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.1,<1.46
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http>=1.45.1,<1.46
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-common>=1.45.1,<1.46
opentelemetry-proto>=1.45.1,<1.46
opentelemetry-instrumentation>=0.66b1,<0.67
opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests>=0.66b1,<0.67
opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading>=0.66b1,<0.67
opentelemetry-semantic-conventions>=0.66b1,<0.67
opentelemetry-util-http>=0.66b1,<0.67
